Found far off the [[Kesh/Legends|Keshiri]] continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]], this deserted '''island''' was visited in [[4985 BBY]] by [[Adari Vaal]] and her [[Keshiri resistance]], after their failed attempt to overthrow the rule of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. After flying their [[uvak]] into the jet stream above the [[Sessal Spire]] in an attempt to kill the valuable beasts, Vaal and the rest expected to die, but instead awoke on the island, finding little vegetation and only a single ancient [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] corpse. Although she believed prospects to be grim, Vaal eventually escaped the island, making her way to the heavily populated continent of [[Alanciar]].
